user.title: Light routines
user.description: Choose a color mode for each routine. White temperature is applied only in White temperature mode; the RGB picker applies only in RGB mode. Temperature is limited to each bulb’s supported range. All selected bulbs must support the chosen mode. Manual start/stop remains available when automatic starts are disabled. Changes are saved for the next run; an active fade keeps its original duration, target and color. Start times use whole minutes.

error.required_values: Enter a name and select at least one light.
error.not_dimmable: Every selected light must expose brightness control.
error.lights_in_use: A selected light already belongs to another Light Routines entry.
error.routine_active: Stop the active routine before changing its selected lights. Other settings can be saved for the next run.
error.same_start_time: Choose different start times when both automatic routines are enabled.
error.unsupported_color: A selected bulb cannot use this color mode. For tunable-white bulbs choose White temperature, not RGB.
error.invalid_number: Use whole numbers within the displayed limits.
error.invalid_time: Enter a valid local start time.
